title: Salt Orris on a salt pan at dawn

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. The flacon rests on the crust of a white salt pan, hexagonal salt plates cracked around its base and a shallow pink-tinged brine pool behind it mirroring the pale dawn sky. Low sun from behind and to the left rims the glass and throws the liquid into a soft glow, a long blue shadow falling toward camera. 60mm macro from salt level, the horizon in the upper quarter, the salt crystals in the foreground crisp.
